dict.string: Motion, compass, and barometer swing the hanging chain, raise the balloon, tilt smoke and cloth, and aim the mercury.
The microphone listens for tones so sand on the Chladni plate can settle on standing-wave nodes.
The TrueDepth camera tracks your face so metal highlights and the diorama can move with your head.
Location is used only to correct magnetic north into true north for the mercury compass.
